scope: Authored *.tf,course.tfvars,*.tftest.hcl only; no state,credential files,.env or provider cache read. Pattern checks are not a secret scanner.
iam: Reviewed explicit Allow actions/resource references in modules/identity/main.tf; universal TLS wildcard Deny only; ECR auth and KMS-key-policy exceptions documented. Graph no-write invariant asserted by mock test.
encryption: Inspected project CMK with rotation, S3/KMS, DDB/KMS+PITR, SQS/KMS,ECR/KMS; optional bootstrap AWS-managed AES256/DDB encryption. All checked in mock assertions.
public_access: Inspected all S3 public access blocks, owner-enforced ACLs,TLS denies,default SG revocation,role SG links,data routes,no public instance IPs. No actual AWS exposure claim.
deletion: Inspected literal S3 prevent_destroy,default force_destroy=false,native table protection,explicit cleanup controls; bootstrap additionally protected. Human-controlled source change required for S3 teardown.
scanner: Neither Trivy nor Checkov available at coordinator preflight. Manual fallback only; no independent security approval.
